modelingRecipe.referenceGate: Only use panels whose referenceStatus starts with approved. needs-review panels require inspection before modeling.

rules: openings are cells in the wall mesh
windows and doors must have edge loops
do not add floating opening panels
check major wall features beyond windows, doors, and roofs
use satellite roof zones as top-down source of truth
split roofs into named planes or masses before modeling
derive front, rear, left-side, and right-side roof plans from the same roof zones

panels.title: West South Wing
panels.notes: Front west left/south wing: observed repeated sash rhythm is three rows by seven column slots. The center ground slot is reserved for the middle door, giving windows 6 + 7 + 7 = 20; hidden/occluded openings inferred by symmetry.

countInference.proof: west-south-wing: windows rows 6+7+7 = 20; west-south-wing: doors 1 row x 1 = 1
countInference.warning: Doors and windows are counted separately; multiplication proofs never combine them.

primitiveHints.reason: reference-backed exterior facade with integrated openings

roofZones.notes: Main roof mass visible in satellite; split into planes before modeling.
Triangular front roof/gable pediment under the cupola axis; not part of the entry stairs/platform and not part of the tower stack.
Rear/north top roof zone visible from satellite; model as separate roof mass tied into main roof.
South/front end hip cap visible in satellite.
Long rear/east roof strip along the back side; keep separate from main roof blanket.
Square roof support pad around the cupola/tower base; tower must sit on this supported zone.
Satellite-visible small roof boxes/dormers inside this envelope; individual instances need a closer roof pass before final modeling.

front.notes: West/front roof silhouette. Shows main hip roof and the central triangular front gable/pediment prism below the cupola axis.

rear.notes: East/rear roof silhouette. Shows rear hip mass and rear/east strip without the front gable pediment.

left-side.notes: South/left-side roof silhouette. Shows long hip mass and front/rear cap slopes.

right-side.notes: North/right-side roof silhouette. Shows main hip plus the rear/east roof strip seen along the back side.
